::: {.callout-important}
## Before your first commit

Run `quarto render` once in this folder. The first render adds the
template's rules to `.gitignore`, which keep fitted models and other large
files out of git. It also writes `README.md`, the page for the site's
readers, unless a `README.md` already exists. The guide for authors is
`GUIDE.md`.

Put the paper title, citation, DOIs, and data files in `_supplement.yml`.
This page reads them from there. Then delete this box.
:::

This site hosts the supplemental analysis reports, code, and data for:

## Archived Version

A frozen, citable copy of these materials is archived on Zenodo. The DOI
badge and the download link show here after you add the values under
`zenodo` in `_supplement.yml`.

{{< supplement-doi >}} {{< supplement-download >}}
